title: World-by-world nonhuman palette: every start, continuity boundary and source-range mismatch
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full source-qualified world palette; scenario and current authority boundaries retained
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full review covers the complete source map, W01–W16 including all five separate W04 continuities, all54 proposed starts, NC1–NC14, NX1–NX10 and S1–S5. Source confidence and implementation status remain independent. CF means a bounded proposed compatible scenario, not a canon player route; CF? requires the named qualification; an explicitly changed premise is AU. An UNKNOWN mind, physiology or legal rule is not proof canon forbids it, and labelling an illustrative autonomous-organism/portrait/construct proposal AU does not establish that every possible native mind route would require changing canon. No appearance grants the protagonist's mastery, property, citizenship, consent or source package.

F2. Retain each source's actual boundary: seven HP novels versus opted-in supplements; D&D edition versus setting; WN member numbers versus printed chapters/LN/anime; separate fan continuity versus baseline JJK; manga/Brotherhood versus2003 FMA; original Naruto versus Boruto supplement; dated wiki snapshots versus authenticated primary canon. W04's five titles are separate worlds, not one composite species law. Where a short source-family label lacks its full title, a selected lookup must recover the exact held title rather than acquire a book by the acronym. The report's cross-links and public-page citations are historical inspected evidence, not new primary-book/web reads here.

F3. The dense tables preserve useful exception boundaries: fixed replica versus growing Shadow versus source-specific avatar, remote proxy versus soul-linked copy, autonomous mind versus independent reserve, artifact custody versus occupant willingness, member reports versus hive consciousness, anchor versus supply, and actual repair versus new copy. Specific source rights exclusions are not universal merchant hostility, body weakness or narrator morality. Translation/detection, true identity, authority and actual control remain separate unless a particular sourced mechanism joins them. A new independent person can have a useful native life without generic human-school admission or a forced return-to-human endpoint.

F4. Observation hazard, source-loss catastrophe, finite action fuel, optional advancement ingredient and ordinary nourishment require different effects. Preserve the food direction without falsely promising every form survives all combat, anchor destruction or actual source loss. Genuine high capability, immunity, parallel activity and renewable production remain possible under AD22/AD38; the mundane examples do not impose global counters or equalized power. A successful arrival still needs real destination habitat, reach and useful next play. A waiting carried/dependent actor needs selected local work/contact/recovery terms, not an invented escape or takeover faculty.

F5. The source ledger has a concrete range inconsistency: RI is introduced as accepted721–740 and961–980, while W16 also cites RI-c0981-02. Preserve that locator but qualify its exact source/acceptance window before using it as evidence within the stated span. Old blocked Naruto/insufficient Worm-ORV searches are search-route limits, not negative canon evidence. The later selected HP scenes in SS-B/B241 can qualify their exact freedom/work/tray precedents without closing all W01 physiology, binding or transit gaps. Earlier Soldier storage absolutes were already qualified by later evidence; do not revive them from the old volume table.

F6. HP-first ranking and1366-primary proof target are historical, not the current campaign queue. Current Klein/LOTM, Harry developer-route, desktop prose-first and AD36/AD43 owners govern selected work; AD42 keeps review optional. The B=E1/E2/E14/E15 shorthand describes proposed consumer needs rather than a blanket all-world migration embargo or proof those seams are all absent. AD51 supports designing shared seams with a real first consumer and validating reuse across a different world. Under AD32 the54 starts, pattern rows and ranking remain proposals. This review adds no runtime, primary-canon, source-acquisition, native admission, migration, browser or save proof.
reviews.evidence: Entire394-line input delivered in ranges1–130,131–260,261–394. No linked primary text, source dossiers or public webpages freshly inspected.
reviews.reopen: Selected source/era/physiology/rights consumer, especially RI-c0981-02 range qualification; preserve exact source scope without broad all-world rereads or negative canon inference.
